test_gtn_equal: test two gtn graphs for equality comparing nodes arcs labels and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test two gtn graphs for isomorphism ignoring node ordering but checking structure
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file and verify it matches expected graph
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file and verify the output format
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn graph to a binary file and verify roundtrip equality
